sections.html:
Merrillville is a town in Ross Township, Lake County, part of the Chicago metro area in Northwest Indiana. Its center is where Interstate 65 meets U.S. Route 30, and it spreads over about 33.3 square miles and touches Gary, Hobart, Winfield, Crown Point, Schererville and Griffith.

Population stood at 36,444 in 2020, compared with 35,246 in 2010 and 30,560 in 2000, and the 2025 estimate is 37,407. Merrillville took the title of Indiana's largest town by population in January 2015, and a town manager runs it instead of a mayor. Median household income is $62,221 and median age is 40.0.

sections.h2: What shapes demand for Merrillville houses
sections.html:
Merrillville is a retail hub for the region. Big-box stores, hotels, restaurants and car dealers line the U.S. 30 corridor between Taft Street and Colorado Street. NiSource, White Lodging and Centier Bank all have their headquarters in town, and Ameriplex at the Crossroads, an industrial and technology park, sits on Broadway.

Steel and refining belong to other parts of Lake County, not to Merrillville itself. Lake effect snow and big temperature swings wear on roofs, gutters, sump pumps and heating systems, so postponed upkeep shows fast. A buyer relying on a mortgage will often demand those fixes, and that demand pushes some owners toward a direct purchase.

The wider county matters too. Lake County is the second most populous county in Indiana, with 19 incorporated cities and towns and Hammond the largest at 77,879 residents. Buyers and investors shop the whole county, so a Merrillville house competes with homes in Crown Point, Schererville and Griffith. Location near the I-65 and U.S. 30 crossing helps a listing, but it does little for a house that needs a new roof or has an aging furnace that a buyer's inspector will flag.

Taxes and deeds run through Lake County rather than the town hall. Crown Point is the county seat and home to the Treasurer. For tax sales, go to the Auditor's office at 2293 North Main Street, Building A, 2nd Floor (219-755-3155, weekdays 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.).

The town handles building and zoning. Call the county for taxes and recording, and the town for permits and rental questions.

The Planning and Building Department enforces Merrillville's building codes and zoning ordinances. It is at 7820 Broadway, Merrillville, IN 46410. The department phone is 219-769-3631 and the town main line is 219-769-5711.

The department's documents page offers a rental registration application, along with contractor, variance and subdivision forms. Rent out the house you want to sell? Ask whether your registration is current before closing. Phone as well about permits, fees and certificate of occupancy rules, because the steps vary by property.

Even an owner-occupied house can carry a half-finished project. Inspectors and title companies ask about permits, and settling the question early keeps closing day on schedule.

sections.h2: Property tax due dates and tax sales
sections.html:
Indiana Code 6-1.1-22-9 sets two installments, on May 10 and November 10. The Lake County Treasurer posts the exact schedule and payment options each year.

Lake County sells tax-delinquent parcels at an online auction run through zeusauction.com. Bidding in 2026 ran from Friday, September 4 through Tuesday, September 8, and registration cost $100. When taxes on your house are behind, learn the sale calendar before fixing a closing date, since paying the balance in time keeps the parcel out of the auction.

Call 219-755-3155 to find out what is owed and whether your parcel appears on a list.

sections.h2: Questions to answer before you list or sell
sections.html:
A few answers will shape every offer you see.

  • Is anyone besides you named on the deed, and is there a mortgage to pay off?
  • Are both tax installments for the year paid, or does the Treasurer show a balance?
  • Do tenants live in the house, and is the rental registered with the town?
  • Is any repair, permit or town notice still open?

Lake County offices and the town departments listed above can answer most of these in a call or two. Write down the amounts you hear, the name of the office and the date you called, because balances change as installments come due and penalties accrue.

sections.h2: How deeds are handled in Lake County
sections.html:
Under Indiana Code 6-1.1-5.5-3, the two sides fill out a sales disclosure form ahead of the auditor's step, and the county assessor must approve it first. Contiguous parcels in one taxing district can share a single form when one deed moves them.

Filing is normally the title company's job. You sign, and you confirm which names appear on the deed.

People sell after a move, an inheritance, a bad rental experience or a repair bill they cannot cover. Each of those leads to the same fork: list the house or sell directly.

  • A listing involves getting the house ready, hosting showings and then waiting through a buyer's loan and inspection.
  • A cash purchase accepts the house in its present state, and the closing day is yours.

Line up what you would net, how long each route takes and how much work it asks of you.

sections.h2: How does a cash sale close in Merrillville?
sections.html:
1. Give us the address and describe the house: who owns it, what shape it is in, and whether tenants or town notices are involved.
  2. A written offer follows, and you can take your time comparing it with a listing.
  3. Once you say yes, a title company opens a file, searches the title and checks what remains on taxes and any mortgage.
  4. Both sides sign the disclosure form and the deed, and the title company records the transfer in Lake County.
  5. Anything owed on taxes, liens or a mortgage comes out of the proceeds. The rest is paid to you.

Gather the deed, a recent tax bill, the lease for a rented house and any letter from the Planning and Building Department. With no lender involved, the pace depends mainly on the title work and what suits you.

sections.h2: Selling a rental or a house that needs work
sections.html: A cash buyer will take a house that needs work, and you pick the date. With tenants in place, share the lease and say what it says about when it ends. Confirm your registration with the Planning and Building Department at 219-769-3631 so the file reads cleanly when the title company reviews it. If a prior owner or contractor left a project open, explain it plainly; buyers price what they know, and surprises discovered later cost sellers more than disclosed problems do.

faqs.q: Is Merrillville a city or a town?
faqs.a: It is a town, incorporated in 1971 and managed by a town manager. Among Indiana towns it has the largest population.

faqs.q: Do Merrillville landlords have to register rentals?
faqs.a: The town's planning and building documents page offers a rental registration application. Call the department at 219-769-3631 to confirm the current requirements for your house.

faqs.q: When are property taxes due in Lake County?
faqs.a: State law sets May 10 and November 10. The county treasurer posts the exact schedule and payment options.

faqs.q: Which county office do I call about my deed?
faqs.a: Lake County handles recording and the sales disclosure form, with Crown Point as the county seat. A title company normally does the filing for you.

faqs.q: Can I sell my Merrillville house as-is?
faqs.a: Yes. A cash buyer can purchase it without repairs, and you choose the closing date.
